title: Saved focus-wheel preparation interface on a second isolated run
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Open the proof workspace, click Workflows, choose the saved focus-wheel workflow and click Use saved process.

manualSteps.label: Attach second run
manualSteps.instruction: Open its recorded run link and inspect the basis result and waiting review.

manualSteps.label: Reuse
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface, select Focus-wheel configured preparation and click Open saved interface. Leave Approve untouched.

manualSteps.label: Reload
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the working interface and inspect the same second-run basis and declared review.

steps.label: Workspace offers Workflows
steps.purpose: Verify the normal workspace route with real API owners.
steps.action: Open Repeated focus-wheel preparation proof workspace.
steps.expected: The workspace loads and offers Workflows.
steps.actual: Normal workspace and Workflows control visible.

steps.label: Workflows opens the editor
steps.summary: The established workflow editor is available inside the workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify actual workspace entry without mocking.

steps.label: Workflow file controls
steps.summary: The workspace offers named saved workflows.
steps.purpose: Use the existing saved file chooser.

steps.label: Choose the focus-wheel workflow
steps.summary: The exact accepted focus-wheel workflow appears in the saved files.
steps.purpose: Choose the engineering process by its saved file.
steps.expected: The accepted focus-wheel workflow is listed.

steps.label: Focus-wheel workflow diagram
steps.summary: The original focus-wheel assignment opens with its connected review, geometry and slicing stages.
steps.purpose: Keep authoring and working views on the accepted source.
steps.action: Choose the accepted focus-wheel workflow file.
steps.expected: Accepted heat diagram and working view action available.
steps.actual: Exact saved focus-wheel source is open.

steps.label: Shared working view
steps.summary: The process working interface opens in another Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Verify shared inputs and readiness without creating another executor.
steps.expected: Common working view in a workspace tab.

steps.label: Attach the actual focus-wheel run
steps.summary: The working view reads the same isolated backend run.
steps.purpose: Use actual process state for interface composition.
steps.action: Reopen the recorded focus-wheel run link.
steps.expected: The common working view attaches without starting another run.

steps.label: Second run waits at its declared review
steps.summary: The common view shows only the second run basis and exact waiting review.
steps.purpose: Compare the backend contract before opening the saved UI.
steps.action: Inspect the common view; leave its review unanswered.
steps.expected: One second-run result and the declared review.
steps.actual: Second-run waiting state and exact basis result are visible.

steps.label: Saved comparison reused
steps.summary: The same built revision follows the second run with its distinct basis result and waiting review.
steps.purpose: Prove reuse of existing built assets without another authoring job.
steps.action: Select the saved focus-wheel preparation interface and click Open saved interface.
steps.expected: The same saved revision displays only second-run state.
steps.actual: Saved comparison displays the second-run basis and declared review.

steps.label: Reload reconciles the same second run
steps.summary: Reload restores the same built UI and pending second-run review.
steps.purpose: Separate view lifetime from backend work.
steps.action: Reload the saved working interface; leave Approve untouched.
steps.expected: No start, model generation, save or review dispatch.
steps.actual: Same second-run evidence restored with no authoring/execution mutation.
